formacion.title: Learning fast is the skill that decides who adapts to AI.
formacion.lede: I've been a professor at Universidad EAFIT for 15 years and building software and AI for 13. I bring both crafts together in Learning Sprints for teams and live cohorts for professionals, with a method tested in the classroom and in production.

method.label: // the method
method.title: The MAPA Method
method.desc: Four steps to learn any skill in weeks, not months. It combines ultralearning principles, experiential learning, and AI as a tutor.

steps.title: Map
steps.text: Break the skill down and find the 20% that delivers 80% of the result.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Practice from day one on a real project, not in theory.

steps.title: Practice the hard parts
steps.text: Isolated drills on weak spots and active recall so it sticks.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: Fast feedback, with AI as a tutor, iterating every week.

offers.label: // how we work
offers.title: Two ways to learn with me

items.title: Learning Sprints
items.text: Four-week remote programs that take your team from theory to using a new skill in their real work, including AI adoption.
bullets: Facilitated live sessions and challenges built on your company's real cases
Standalone workshops from 90 minutes to half a day
Tailored proposal based on team size and goals

items.title: Live cohorts
items.text: Small groups that learn a skill in 4 to 6 weeks with the MAPA Method, guidance, and community.
bullets: AI as a tutor, with tested prompts and routines
Next cohort: message me to join the waitlist
